title: Finalize a submitted order
objective: Confirm that finalization reaches FINALIZED state and provides the required visible confirmation.
preconditions: A synthetic order exists in SUBMITTED state.

test_data.name: order reference
test_data.description: <existing synthetic order reference for an order in SUBMITTED state>

steps.action: From Orders, open Search and locate the order using its test reference.
steps.expected_result: A matching order row is displayed.

steps.action: Open the matching order and review its items and current state.
steps.expected_result: The order details are displayed with the order in SUBMITTED state.
The order state changes to FINALIZED and a visible confirmation is shown.

postconditions: The synthetic order is in FINALIZED state.
cleanup: Remove the synthetic order using an approved test-environment procedure.
notes: Selected implementation evidence changes the state but does not expose the visible confirmation required by ORD-008.
